children: Endovia Health Sciences welcomed federal support for Schedule III and expects to submit a CannEpil Z pre-submission to the FDA in the coming week.
Federal counsel supported moving marijuana from Schedule I to Schedule III during recent DEA hearings, signaling regulatory change.
Endovia expects to submit a Z pre-submission and request a pre-submission conference with the FDA for CannEpil in the coming week.
Company says Schedule III could ease federal barriers to cannabinoid research and FDA-regulated development pathways.
Endovia is reviewing additional cannabinoid formulations, IP and potential licensing, acquisition or collaboration opportunities.
Working with capital partners to finalize expanded financing to support development, licensing and operational expansion.
